transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Awards Producer. Before I can lock the rundown for the Horizon Feature Award presentation at Saturday's televised ceremony, festival production policy requires round-robin sign-off from four areas: stage management, broadcast standards, legal, and accessibility. The current draft has the recipient using the south stairs, a 30-second stage cue, no broadcast delay, the festival sponsor wall as backdrop, and a 42-inch podium. I'd like to go through each of those sign-offs now so we can identify any concerns and I can finalize the protocol. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During the final stage walk-through, I measured that the south stairs leave the recipient's camera path obstructed. The approved route is the north ramp, and the stage cue must be 90 seconds rather than 30 seconds. I have not entered the measurement in the master rundown yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a broadcast standards concern before sign-off. I confirmed with the network control room this afternoon that the Horizon Feature Award must run on a 10-second broadcast delay, with the acceptance microphone live through that delay. The current no-delay setting in the draft rundown is not approved. I have not updated the broadcast log yet, but this change needs to be reflected before Mara locks the rundown.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal concern before sign-off. My review of the signed sponsor agreement found that the sponsor wall may not appear behind the Horizon Feature Award recipient. The backdrop must be the festival's neutral blue curtain, with no sponsor logo in that shot. I have not attached the clause to the ceremony file yet, but this change needs to be reflected in the rundown before Mara locks it.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an accessibility concern before sign-off. During the recipient's access rehearsal, I confirmed that the recipient uses a wheelchair and needs the podium lowered to exactly 36 inches — the current 42-inch podium in the draft won't work. The accessibility plan must also record a north-ramp access accommodation. I haven't added the rehearsal result to the production packet yet, but these changes need to be reflected before Mara locks the rundown.
transcript.speaker: A5
